source.dataset: USGS National Hydrography Dataset (public domain), Waterbody - Large Scale, FType 390 (LakePond), AREASQKM 0.05 or more
source.method: every such waterbody meeting the owned zoom-10 tiles of all wave 1 regions, less those meeting a lakes.geojson polygon (Lake Union and Lake Washington keep their datum rule), less those meeting a DEPARE of the wave 1 ENC cells of bands 3 to 5 (charted water), less TIDAL (tide-gated or tidal water, ruled on PR #105); cut to the owned tiles less clip/canada-wa.geojson, holes filled, simplified (shapely) at 0.000050 degrees (about 4 m), coordinates rounded to 0.000001 degrees
left_out: unnamed (147684000): pond at Alder and Tansy creeks, Chinook
Old Channel (152293421): Old Channel, a slough off Padilla Bay
Crockett Lake (155195574): Crockett Lake, tide-gated behind Keystone
Lake Washington Ship Canal ({320CEA8E-77E1-4210-B127-D1C849121E70}): datum lake
